emails.subject: Re: Harrow & Finch brand refresh - round 2
emails.body:
Hi {{user_first_name}},

Thanks so much for these, the team loved them. Quick summary from our meeting this morning:

- Concept B is the clear favourite. The wheat-sheaf mark works really well on the bags and the van mock-up.
- Could we see B with the warmer palette from Concept A? The green feels a bit "health food shop" for us.
- Ollie wondered if the wordmark could be a touch heavier so it holds up on the window vinyls.
- Concept C is a no, sorry! Too close to what Greggs did last year.

Would it be possible to have the revised version before the review on {{day+6}}? I've sent a calendar invite.

Thanks again, really exciting to see it coming together.

Priya

Priya Nair
